title: Add division by zero guard for diffFromAvg calculation
description: Add null check before division to prevent division by zero when avg is 0
approach: Add conditional guard that returns null for diffFromAvg when avg is 0, and update insight generation logic to handle this edge case gracefully

tasks.title: Add guard for avg === 0 in diffFromAvg calculation
tasks.description: Modify the diffFromAvg calculation to check if avg is 0 before performing division. If avg is 0, set diffFromAvg to null and adjust insight generation to handle this case.
implementation: With: `const diffFromAvg = avg !== 0 ? ((current.value - avg) / avg) * 100 : null;`
Update insight generation logic (lines 73-86) to handle null diffFromAvg
When diffFromAvg is null, skip the volatility insight and fall back to trend or stable insight
acceptance_criteria: No division by zero error when avg is 0
diffFromAvg is null when avg is 0

Existing functionality preserved when avg is non-zero
No NaN or Infinity values displayed in UI
